text:
IncidentBot: 🔔 [PAGE] cluster-3 /v1/stream p99 latency breach. Threshold 5s -> observed 12.4s. Auto-escalation to oncall: Sam (oncall).

Sam (oncall): I'm on it. Noted p99=12.4s, p95=210ms. Which pods impacted? any streaming stalls or just longer tails?

Jia (eng-runtime): quick summary from traces: lots of `nvme read` retries + model step timeouts. Seeing repeated stalls during keyframe flushes. Attaching a snippet of recent node syslog.
```
[ 12:08:11 ] GPU-4 ECC corrected errors: 214
[ 12:08:12 ] PM: CPU thermal_throttle: throttling on package 0
[ 12:08:13 ] kernel: pci 0000:65:00.0: GPU reset failed: -110
[ 12:08:14 ] nvme0n1: I/O 1234 timed out
```

Ravi (eng-sre): that `GPU reset failed` stands out. I just pulled `nvidia-smi -q` from the node (cluster-3-node-07):
```
==============NVSMI LOG==============
GPU 4: Tesla-A100
FB Memory Usage: 40 GiB / 80 GiB
ECC Errors (Corrected): 214
ECC Errors (Uncorrected): 2
Persistence Mode: Enabled
Temperature: 95 C
Performance State: P2
Power Readings: Power Draw: 350 W (limit 400 W)
Throttle Reasons: GPU Idle, Thermal
====================================
```

Ravi (eng-sre): temp=95C + uncorrected ECC > 0 -> potential hardware degradation. I'm marking node-07 as suspect.

Sam (oncall): Is customer impact confirmed? Priya / Maya?

Maya (customer-success): Yes — customer ledgerbot-prod reported multiple streaming stalls, request IDs in support ticket #4682. They saw partial outputs then stalls at ~10s. Ticket linked to their API key.

Priya (product): Impact: a handful of enterprise customers on Dedicated had transient stalls. No data leak. Need rollback or migration plan; customers on dedicated pools should get failover to other nodes quickly.

Sam (oncall): Doing live mitigation: 1) cordon + drain node-07, 2) shift streaming sessions to cluster-1 pool, 3) temporarily lower model concurrency on affected pods to avoid stress. Executing now.

Ravi (eng-sre): Commands I'm running: 
```
kubectl cordon node-07 --context=prod-cluster-3
kubectl drain node-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60
kubectl scale deployment/text-stream --replicas=6 --context=prod-cluster-1
```

Jia (eng-runtime): Also enabling request-level fallback to smaller quantized variant for streams: set header `x-rw-fallback: model-qa/1.2-q4_0` in the routing policy for cluster-3. Quick snippet of emergency routing override: 
```
route-overrides:
  cluster: cluster-3
  priority: emergency
  fallback-model: "gptx-small-q4_0"
  max-threads-per-gpu: 8
```

Sam (oncall): Ops-bot, annotate incident and page hardware team.

ops-bot: @hardware-team alerted: issue flagged on node-07 (ECC errs, temp=95C). Ticket created HW-2026.

Ravi (eng-sre): After drain, 90% of streams shifted within 30s. Post-mitigation metrics: p95 ~ 240ms, p99 ~ 1.1s. Still above baseline p99=400ms but far better than 12s.

Sam (oncall): Good. Putting node-07 into maintenance mode. Next steps: schedule GPU replacement or isolate for vendor diagnostics. Also need postmortem.

Jia (eng-runtime): Root-cause candidates: 1) thermal throttling from fan/dust or degraded heatsink; 2) intermittent PCIe link causing GPU reset; 3) NVMe slowness + IO retries worsening tail latency. We saw coupling between `nvme` timeouts and GPU resets.

Ravi (eng-sre): For immediate triage I'm collecting: `dmesg`, `smartctl -a /dev/nvme0n1`, `nvidia-bug-report.sh`, and `smi --query` logs. Also snapshot of pod logs and model KV cache stats to see eviction storms.

Priya (product): Customer comms: Maya/Tier2 drafts statement: "We observed transient streaming stalls affecting a subset of requests; we've moved workloads off the affected hardware and are investigating. No data exposure." Can we confirm ETA for replacement?

Ravi (eng-sre): ETA for hardware swap depends on vendor SLA — filing HW-2026 now. For immediate stability we'll keep the fallback route active for 24–48h and monitor p99.

Maya (customer-success): I'll update ticket #4682 with mitigation steps and offer a follow-up call. Please paste confirmation once node is marked out of rotation.

Sam (oncall): Handoff: I'm logging this incident and handing to Ravi/Jia for follow-up during daytime shift. I'll remain reachable for questions. Tagging `@eng-sre` and `@eng-runtime` for postmortem and remediation actions.

Ravi (eng-sre): Action items (temp): ["drain node-07", "enable fallback routing for cluster-3", "monitor p95/p99, stream success rate"]. Post-incident: ["replace GPU/HW diagnostics", "validate cooling and airflow", "correlate NVMe IO errors with GPU resets", "run burn-in on replacement node"].

Jia (eng-runtime): Adding a quick check to runtime health: if ECC uncorrected > 0 OR temperature > 90C -> immediate node offramp to avoid tail amplification. Will PR to infra-configs.

Sam (oncall): Thanks team. I'll update the incident channel after postmortem draft. Closing active page for now. :white_check_mark:
